source: DR 08 T4-4 — PF-EEINT-001, the employee side
_source: "Employee's own RPF contribution ₹6,00,000 in the year; employer also contributes." "PF-EEINT-001: employer DOES contribute → threshold is 2,50,000; excess contribution = 3,50,000". As DR 08's W-074b erratum (D-209): the computation is read (Rules 1962 r.9D; S4 r.277) and charges the fund's taxable-account interest, which the case does not state — entered as nil, so other-sources income is nil. DR 08 states no regime; OS-PF-TAXABLE-INTEREST applies in every regime, so the default (new) regime. No employer contribution amount is stated, so none is entered and nothing is added to salary. INFERENCE, not DR 08's: the nil interest, the regime, the nil charge.
